sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: `#sanojjonasRoot` (sanojjonas third-party userscript container) could survive on a fully-rendered `/series/<mbid>` page: the pageType whitelist gating its cleanup/late-injection watcher never included `series-releases`. Removed the whitelist entirely — cleanup now runs unconditionally on every page, so this bug class can't recur for the next page type sanojjonas decides to support.
